description: A plugin script for Trumbowyg editor that adds a preformatted code block feature with multilingual support and functions to handle selection and unwrapping of code blocks.

methods.name: getSelectionParentElement
methods.description: Returns the parent element of the current selection.

methods.name: strip
methods.description: Removes HTML tags from a string, returning plain text.

methods.name: unwrapCode
methods.description: Unwraps code and pre tags from selected content, with special handling for IE.
